// diagnostic E0769

Jet.LabelOnlyPassedByPosition

A label-only parameter, declared after `*`, was passed by position

What

A label-only parameter, declared after `*`, was passed by position

Why

Parameters after `*` must be passed by label, so the call says what each value means

Fix

Pass the label-only parameter by name.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.LabelOnlyPassedByPosition: Tests/UI/arg_label_required.stderr.

Error: Jet.LabelOnlyPassedByPosition: `timeout` is a label-only parameter of `connect`
  --> Tests/UI/arg_label_required.jet:3:39
    |
  3 | run: fn() { _: connect("db.internal", 5) }
    |                                       ^
 Why: The `*` in the declaration requires the label, so the call says what the value means
 Fix: Write `timeout: …` for this argument
